info.title: Tailwind Universal API
info.description: Tailwind lets you manage Pinterest publishing through Tailwind by listing connected accounts, browsing boards and smart schedule timeslots, and creating, scheduling, reviewing, or deleting posts.

post.description: Creates a new post in Tailwind.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

mediaUrl.description: Publicly accessible image or video URL to pin.

title.description: Pin title. Required when scheduling via sendAt.

description.description: Pin description. Required when scheduling via sendAt.

url.description: Destination URL when the pin is clicked. Required when scheduling via sendAt.

boardId.description: Target board ID. Required when scheduling via sendAt.

sendAt.description: ISO 8601 time to schedule the post. If omitted, the post is saved as a draft.

isSimplifiedPin.description: Whether to create a simplified pin. Defaults to true.

createdAt.description: Creation time as a Unix timestamp.

sendAt.description: Scheduled send time as a Unix timestamp.

sentAt.description: Actual send time as a Unix timestamp.
